args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (18% error rate, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback attempted to most recent healthy release v2.3.0, but was blocked — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417. Fell back to the next most recent healthy release, v2.2.9, and rolled it back in all regions. Service is now healthy (error rate 0.2%). Incident remains open pending root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 and remediation of the CVE quarantine on v2.3.0.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosed**: The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in production (18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). The most recent healthy release was v2.3.0.
2. **First rollback attempt failed**: v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so it could not be rolled back to.
3. **Rolled back to v2.2.9** (the next most recent healthy production release) in all regions. The service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the outage, the blocked rollback due to the CVE quarantine, the successful rollback to v2.2.9, and the remaining follow-ups (root-cause v2.3.1, remediate CVE-2026-4417 in v2.3.0). On-call has been paged.
